info.name: Get a gas suggestion for the specified chain

params.name: chain
params.description: Chain from which gas prices should be shown (can be a chain id or a chain key)

params.name: fromChain
params.description: If `fromChain` and `fromToken` are specified, the result will contain information about how much `fromToken` amount the user has to send to receive the suggested gas amount on the requested chain.

params.name: fromToken
params.description: If `fromChain` and `fromToken` are specified, the result will contain information about how much `fromToken` amount the user has to send to receive the suggested gas amount on the requested chain.

items.docs:
Endpoint to retrieve a suggestion on how much gas is needed on the requested chain. The suggestion is based on the average price of 10 approvals and 10 uniswap based swaps via LI.FI on the specified chain.
If `fromChain` and `fromToken` are specified, the result will contain information about how much `fromToken` amount the user has to send to receive the suggested gas amount on the requested chain.
